summary: Intermap Technologies filed a Form 6-K on August 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing the appointment of former senior diplomat John T. McNamara to the Board of Advisors of its subsidiary, Intermap Federal Services. The filing is a routine current report for a foreign private issuer; the appointment is an ordinary management advisory addition, not a forced or abrupt departure or a strategic corporate event. No deal terms, financial details, or special-situation mechanics are present. This is a standard personnel announcement with no implications for shareholders.
